# gouvernance-manquante

*Governance gap: rules, training or oversight missing*

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-france-most-cautious-market" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/france-most-cautious-market/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="France is the most cautious market on enterprise AI, and the least prepared." markdown>

**France is the most cautious market on enterprise AI, and the least prepared.** In an FTI Consulting survey of 1,600 senior decision-makers across seven markets, 34% of French respondents favour a cautious, control-first approach, the highest share. France nonetheless ranks last on employee training (26%), written AI policies (28%) and risk assessment before project launch (37%). Across all markets, 60% slowed, paused or cancelled a planned AI deployment in the past 12 months. [L'Usine Digitale, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.usine-digitale.fr/intelligence-artificielle/ia-en-entreprise-la-france-championne-de-la-prudence-mais-derniere-sur-la-formation-des-salaries-et-levaluation-des-risques.JMLVNUU4ZJH4PASD5R3RRP54ZE.html) · [FTI Consulting release, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.fticonsulting.com/fr-fr/france/newsroom/large-companies-slowing-down-adoption-ai)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-fca-ai-governance-review" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/fca-ai-governance-review/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="The UK financial regulator finds firms deploying AI before deciding how to govern it." markdown>

**The UK financial regulator finds firms deploying AI before deciding how to govern it.** The FCA's review says firms "designed and deployed AI use cases without first considering how to govern them", and that retrofitting governance "left gaps in accountability". Good practice is structured challenge, testing and sign-off before deployment; a recurring weakness is human review that becomes a "tick-box exercise". [FCA, 19 Oct 2026](https://www.fca.org.uk/publications/good-poor-practice/ai-financial-services)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-us-companies-bypass-governance" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/us-companies-bypass-governance/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Nearly half of large US companies have bypassed their own AI governance." markdown>

**Nearly half of large US companies have bypassed their own AI governance.** In an EY survey of 202 senior leaders at $1bn+ public companies, 47% said their organisation had skipped its governance process for an urgent deployment. 49% have not updated their framework for agentic AI risks, and 26% could not detect unauthorised agents operating internally. [TechInformed, 23 Sep 2026](https://techinformed.com/nearly-half-of-big-us-firms-have-bypassed-ai-governance/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-french-consulting-branch-ai-barometer" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/french-consulting-branch-ai-barometer/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="In France&#x27;s engineering and consulting branch, nine firms in ten use AI and 47% have no rules." markdown>

**In France's engineering and consulting branch, nine firms in ten use AI and 47% have no rules.** The first OPIIEC barometer (606 firms) puts average AI maturity at 47/100 and finds only 29% have named an AI lead. Data security and compliance weigh most heavily in engineering studies and consulting, where client trust conditions any deployment. [Solutions Numériques, 16 Sep 2026](https://www.solutions-numeriques.com/ia-dans-les-bureaux-detudes-90-des-entreprises-ont-franchi-le-cap-la-gouvernance-reste-a-construire/)
